speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue and unintentional weight loss. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any changes in your appetite, night sweats, or fever recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful; the combination of weight loss with a preserved appetite in a 72-year-old is concerning for malignancy or chronic infection. Given your age, have you noticed any lumps, night sweats, or bone pain recently? REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, ESR, CRP.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count: WBC 16,000 /μL (elevated), Hemoglobin 11 g/dL (low), Platelets Normal. ESR: Not provided. CRP: Not provided.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have 5 kg unintentional weight loss over 6 months, Good appetite.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Patient denies any chronic illnesses or prior hospitalizations. Social history: Retired engineer; denies tobacco use or illicit drug use. Drinks alcohol socially.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, night sweats, changes in bowel or bladder habits, recent infections, or bleeding disorders. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your concern, but to identify the cause of your weight loss and fatigue, I must first review the blood work. REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, CRP. While we await those results, can you confirm if you have noticed any new, painless, rubbery lumps in your neck, armpits, or groin, or any persistent bone pain?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count: WBC 16,000 /μL (elevated), Hemoglobin 11 g/dL (low), Platelets Normal. ESR: Not provided. CRP: Not provided.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma. The combination of age, constitutional symptoms (weight loss, fatigue), leukocytosis, and anemia is highly suspicious for a hematologic malignancy. REQUEST IMAGES: CT Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis and Neck Ultrasound.
